basics.name: Yongeun Cho
basics.label: Machine Learning Researcher & Engineer
basics.summary: M.S. student in Data Science at Stony Brook University. Research spans video foundation models, model interpretability, computer vision, and multimodal AI systems.

work.name: Stony Brook Medicine
work.summary: Studied how pretrained video foundation models represent spatiotemporal evidence in clinical video.
highlights: Built interpretability pipeline using frozen V-JEPA representations from 3,600+ ICU clips.
Implemented Top-K Sparse Autoencoders with multi-seed stability testing and optical-flow grounding.
Counterfactual auditing framework outperformed native attention by +0.23 logit.

work.name: Mand.ro
work.summary: Optimized real-time EMG visualization for prosthetic control.
highlights: Replaced Matplotlib visualization with OpenCV, reducing latency to under 1 second.
Improved signal-to-visual responsiveness for assistive robotics/HMI.
Computer Vision Lab · Advisor: Prof. Zhaozheng Yin
Focus: Video Foundation Models, Interpretability, Computer Vision
